SaveName: Haute & Hazard - Solo Circuit v0.2 Add-On
Note: Experimental Solo Circuit v0.2 add-on. Additive-load into the v7.9 TTS base.
Rules: Use docs/SOLO_CIRCUIT_AUTOMA_PLAYTEST.md. Four-round Stage timer; v7.9 play-generated Tips.

ObjectStates.Name: Notecard
ObjectStates.Description:
EXPERIMENTAL ONE-PLAYER MODULE

1. Load Haute & Hazard v7.9 TTS base.
2. Additively load this save.
3. Shuffle the 18-card Automa deck.
4. Choose one Personality or play generic.
5. Recommended first test: Working Queen + Beginner Mode.

House Base Appeal = max(0, Stage Slay Target - 6).
Stage Timer: 4 rounds.

† Working prototype term; subject to legal/IP and publisher review.
